name: Cortex keys, two consecutive aliases (A, A, B, B): the episodic memory keyed on the cortex against the founder key
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-56, EXP-57, EXP-59 and EXP-60 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): the chain seen three ways after the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, the hold rule, the reading in sequence, the boundary of the rule; the queued EXP-63 proposed the outcome gate; the consecutive-alias topology is Huncho's Stone Age V7.4 (https://github.com/ali12mahmood12345-boop/cadence-stone-age/blob/main/docs/V7_RESULTS.md)
question: With Brain.compose(..., memory_choice=True): do the place and ctx5 arms of the context-key screen keep their clean greedy passes, sampled success and first-try accuracy when the episodic records are keyed on the cortex state of each decision (memory_key="cortex") instead of the observation?
scope: component: the episodic memory's key source in V5's four-stage chain seen two consecutive aliases (A, A, B, B); the brain, chamber, founders, signals and readings of the context-key screen

world.note: A, A, B, B: Huncho's Stone Age V7.4 topology with the hidden view's A and B; the right first and third actions change nothing seen, so only the brain's own correct actions tell stage 2 from stage 1 and stage 4 from stage 3

sensory.note: Brain.compose(7, 5, modules=(48, 24), arousal=True, memory_choice=True): the founder key, the observation (memory_key="sensory")

cortex.note: the same brain with memory_key="cortex": the place records keyed by the association activity each decision settled to, the context built from those keys; the founder's wiring and initial weights

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: natural: none; corrective: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window (V5's corrective teacher)

evaluation.note: a frozen copy read at the arm's seam under its own rule: 100 sampled episodes from a reset each, the reading in sequence (first try per stage, retries), and one greedy episode (a clean pass: four stages in four decisions)

seeds.note: the 48 fresh founders of the context-key screen (202001 to 202048), every arm under both recipes: 96 founder-signal pairs per arm and recipe

analysis.unit: founder and signal; a pair is one arm on one founder under one signal, sensory recipe against cortex recipe
analysis.readings: a frozen copy of each arm at its seam, Brain.reset before each episode: one greedy episode (a clean pass is four stages in four decisions), 100 sampled episodes (success within 10 decisions), first-try accuracy at each stage in sequence
analysis.gate: for each arm kind (place, ctx5): cortex minus sensory, paired means pooled over both signals, at least -.05 for the clean greedy pass rate, for sampled success and for first-try accuracy at each of the four stages (the screen's margins, point estimates); the cortex key meets this view when all twelve differences meet the margin
analysis.report: paired means with their SEM over the 96 pairs; clean passes as discordant pairs with exact two-sided McNemar; each recipe's place against ctx5 as the screen reported it; the sensory recipe against the 15 October screen's ctx5 (48 founders) and place (24 founders) readings as a reproduction check
